lyrics.ja: Yo! Say 夏が 胸を刺激する
lyrics.romaji: Yo! Say Natsu ga Mune wo Shigeki Suru
lyrics.en: Yo! Say, summer excites my heart
lyrics.zh: Yo! Say 夏天刺激著胸口

lyrics.ja: ナマ足 魅惑の マーメイド
lyrics.romaji: Nama Ashi Miwaku no Maameido
lyrics.en: Bare legs—bewitching mermaids
lyrics.zh: 裸足的美人魚，散發魅惑

lyrics.ja: 出すとこ出して たわわになったら
lyrics.romaji: Dasu Toko Dashite Tawawa ni Nattara
lyrics.en: When everything shows and ripens fully
lyrics.zh: 該露的露出來，豐滿誘人時

lyrics.ja: 宝物(ホンモノ)の恋は やれ 爽快っ
lyrics.romaji: Honmono no Koi ha Yare Soukai
lyrics.en: A real love—bring it on, so refreshing!
lyrics.zh: 真正的戀愛，來吧，暢快淋漓

lyrics.ja: ゴマカシきかない 薄着の曲線は
lyrics.romaji: Gomakashi Kikanai Usugi no Kyokusen ha
lyrics.en: Curves in thin clothes that can't be hidden
lyrics.zh: 輕薄衣衫下無法掩飾的曲線

lyrics.ja: 確信犯の しなやかな style!
lyrics.romaji: Kakushinhan no Shinayaka na Style!
lyrics.en: A deliberate, supple style!
lyrics.zh: 明知故犯的柔美姿態！

lyrics.ja: 耐水性の 気持ちに切り替わる
lyrics.romaji: Taisuisei no Kimochi ni Kirikawaru
lyrics.en: Switching to waterproof feelings
lyrics.zh: 切換成防水的心情

lyrics.ja: 瞬間の眩しさは いかがなもの
lyrics.romaji: Shunkan no Mabushisa ha Ikaga na Mono
lyrics.en: How about that momentary brilliance?
lyrics.zh: 瞬間的耀眼，感覺如何

lyrics.ja: ココロまで脱がされる 暑い風の誘惑に
lyrics.romaji: Kokoro made Nugasareru Atsui Kaze no Yuuwaku ni
lyrics.en: By the temptation of a hot wind that strips even my heart
lyrics.zh: 被熱風的誘惑剝開到心底

lyrics.ja: 負けちゃって構わないから
lyrics.romaji: Makechatte Kamawanai kara
lyrics.en: I don't mind losing to it
lyrics.zh: 輸給它也無妨

lyrics.ja: 真夏は 不祥事も キミ次第で
lyrics.romaji: Manatsu ha Fushouji mo Kimi Shidai de
lyrics.en: In midsummer, even scandals depend on you
lyrics.zh: 盛夏裡，連醜聞都取決於你

lyrics.ja: 妖精たちが 夏を刺激する
lyrics.romaji: Yousei Tachi ga Natsu wo Shigeki Suru
lyrics.en: Fairies stimulate the summer
lyrics.zh: 妖精們刺激著夏天

lyrics.ja: ナマ足 魅惑の マーメイド
lyrics.romaji: Nama Ashi Miwaku no Maameido
lyrics.en: Bare legs—bewitching mermaids
lyrics.zh: 裸足的美人魚，散發魅惑

lyrics.ja: 出すとこ出して たわわになったら
lyrics.romaji: Dasu Toko Dashite Tawawa ni Nattara
lyrics.en: When everything shows and ripens fully
lyrics.zh: 該露的露出來，豐滿誘人時

lyrics.ja: ほんものの恋が できそうかい?
lyrics.romaji: Honmono no Koi ga Dekisou Kai?
lyrics.en: Think you can find real love?
lyrics.zh: 你談得了真正的戀愛嗎？

lyrics.ja: キミじゃなくても バテぎみにもなるよ
lyrics.romaji: Kimi ja Nakute mo Bate Gimi ni mo Naru yo
lyrics.en: Even without you, I get a bit worn out
lyrics.zh: 就算不是你也會感到疲憊

lyrics.ja: 暑いばっかの街は 憂うつで
lyrics.romaji: Atsui Bakka no Machi ha Yuuutsu de
lyrics.en: A city of nothing but heat is so gloomy
lyrics.zh: 酷熱難耐的城市令人憂鬱

lyrics.ja: スキを見せたら 不意に耳に入る
lyrics.romaji: Suki wo Misetara Fui ni Mimi ni Hairu
lyrics.en: If I let my guard down, it suddenly reaches my ears
lyrics.zh: 一露出破綻，就突然傳入耳中

lyrics.ja: サブいギャクなんかで 涼みたくない
lyrics.romaji: Sabui Gyaku Nanka de Suzumitakunai
lyrics.en: I don't want to cool off with lame jokes
lyrics.zh: 不想靠冷笑話來降溫

lyrics.ja: むせ返る熱帯夜を 彩る花火のように
lyrics.romaji: Musekaeru Nettaiya wo Irodoru Hanabi no You ni
lyrics.en: Like fireworks coloring a suffocating tropical night
lyrics.zh: 如煙火點綴令人窒息的熱帶夜

lyrics.ja: 打ち上げて散る想いなら
lyrics.romaji: Uchiagete Chiru Omoi Nara
lyrics.en: If these feelings are to launch and scatter
lyrics.zh: 若這份情感注定綻放後消散

lyrics.ja: このまま 抱き合って 焦がれるまで
lyrics.romaji: Kono Mama Dakiatte Kogareru made
lyrics.en: Then let's hold each other until we burn
lyrics.zh: 就這樣相擁，直到心焦難耐

lyrics.ja: 妖精たちと 夏をしたくなる
lyrics.romaji: Yousei Tachi to Natsu wo Shitaku Naru
lyrics.en: I want to do summer with the fairies
lyrics.zh: 好想與妖精們共度夏天

lyrics.ja: 熱い欲望は トルネイド
lyrics.romaji: Atsui Yokubou ha Toruneido
lyrics.en: Hot desire is a tornado
lyrics.zh: 熾熱的慾望如龍捲風

lyrics.ja: 出すもの出して 素直になりたい
lyrics.romaji: Dasu Mono Dashite Sunao ni Naritai
lyrics.en: I want to bare it all and be honest
lyrics.zh: 想毫不保留，坦率做自己

lyrics.ja: キミとボクとなら it's alright
lyrics.romaji: Kimi to Boku to Nara It's Alright
lyrics.en: If it's you and me, it's alright
lyrics.zh: 只要是你和我，it's alright

lyrics.ja: 都会のビルの海じゃ 感じなくなってるキミを
lyrics.romaji: Tokai no Biru no Umi ja Kanjinaku Natteru Kimi wo
lyrics.en: In the sea of city buildings, you've grown numb
lyrics.zh: 在都市大樓的海洋中變得麻木的你

lyrics.ja: 冷えたワインの口吻で 酔わせて とろかして
lyrics.romaji: Hieta Wain no Kuchibiru de Yowasete Torokashite
lyrics.en: With the lips of chilled wine, let me intoxicate and melt you
lyrics.zh: 用冰鎮葡萄酒般的雙唇，讓你沉醉融化

lyrics.ja: 差しあげましょう
lyrics.romaji: Sashiagemashou
lyrics.en: I shall offer it to you
lyrics.zh: 讓我獻給你吧

lyrics.ja: 妖精たちが 夏を刺激する
lyrics.romaji: Yousei Tachi ga Natsu wo Shigeki Suru
lyrics.en: Fairies stimulate the summer
lyrics.zh: 妖精們刺激著夏天

lyrics.ja: ナマ足 ヘソ出し マーメイド
lyrics.romaji: Nama Ashi Heso Dashi Maameido
lyrics.en: Bare legs, midriff-baring mermaids
lyrics.zh: 裸足露肚臍的美人魚

lyrics.ja: 恋にかまけて お留守になるのも
lyrics.romaji: Koi ni Kamakete Orusu ni Naru no mo
lyrics.en: Getting distracted by love and neglecting everything
lyrics.zh: 沉溺戀愛而心不在焉

lyrics.ja: ダイスケ的にも オールオッケー!
lyrics.romaji: Daisuke Teki ni mo Ooru Okkee!
lyrics.en: Even from Daisuke's perspective, it's all okay!
lyrics.zh: 以Daisuke的角度來說也完全OK！

lyrics.ja: Yo! Say 夏を 誰としたくなる?
lyrics.romaji: Yo! Say Natsu wo Dare to Shitaku Naru?
lyrics.en: Yo! Say, who do you want to spend summer with?
lyrics.zh: Yo! Say 夏天想和誰一起度過？

lyrics.ja: 一人寝の夜に you can say good bye
lyrics.romaji: Hitori Ne no Yoru ni You Can Say Good Bye
lyrics.en: On nights sleeping alone, you can say goodbye
lyrics.zh: 獨眠的夜裡，you can say good bye

lyrics.ja: 奥の方まで 乾く間ないほど
lyrics.romaji: Oku no Hou made Kawaku Ma Nai Hodo
lyrics.en: So deep inside there's no time to dry
lyrics.zh: 連深處都來不及乾涸

lyrics.ja: ほんものの恋を しま鮮花?
lyrics.romaji: Honmono no Koi wo Shima Senka?
lyrics.en: Shall we have a real love, fresh flower?
lyrics.zh: 來場真正的戀愛，鮮花？
